title: 5-(4-imidazolyl-1-phenyl)-1H-tetrazole based Zn(II) chiral MOF (Metal-Organic Framework) material
abstract: The invention discloses a 5-(4-imidazolyl-1-phenyl)-1H-tetrazole based Zn(II) chiral MOF (Metal-Organic Framework) material. The Zn(II) chiral MOF material is obtained through taking L-Histidine (L-His) as a template agent, dissolving 5-(4-imidazolyl-1-phenyl)-1H-tetrazole (HL) and Zn(NO3)2.6H2O in DMF (N,N-dimethylformamide), adjusting a pH value of the solution with concentrated sulfuric acid, and then, adopting a solvothermal method. The Zn(II) chiral MOF material is used for resolving alanine as a chiral stationary phase material of a chromatography chiral resolution experiment and has a good separating effect on the alanine.
